mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_date, '%Y-%m') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM jbx_opportunity WHERE created_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE() - INTERVAL 5 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01') AND deleted = 'n' AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jbx_opportunity WHERE YEAR(created_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND deleted = 'n' AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

WITH status_dict AS (SELECT 1 AS status, '进行中' AS name UNION ALL SELECT 2, '已赢单' UNION ALL SELECT 3, '已输单' UNION ALL SELECT 4, '已暂停') SELECT sd.name, COALESCE(COUNT(o.id), 0) AS value FROM status_dict sd LEFT JOIN jbx_opportunity o ON sd.status = o.status AND o.deleted = 'n' AND o.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND ( -- 进行中和暂停统计所有时间 o.status IN (1, 4) OR -- 赢单和输单只统计今年（按实际成交日期） (o.status IN (2, 3) AND YEAR (o.actual_close_date) = YEAR (CURDATE())) ) GROUP BY sd.status, sd.name ORDER BY sd.status
